strategy_settings._comment_candle: Options: OHLC, HEIKIN_ASHI. HA smooths entries by recalculating OHLC based on previous bars.
strategy_settings._comment_late_entry: If true, bot enters anytime a signal is active. If false, it ONLY enters on the very first candle of a new signal.
strategy_settings._comment_gap: Wait 3m (one full candle) before re-entering to avoid whipsaws.
strategy_settings._comment_order_type: Options: LIMIT, MARKET. Limit orders reduce slippage but may not fill in fast markets.

strike_selection._comment_mode: ATM_OFFSET(use 'strike_step' with this option), PREMIUM: Target option price (use 'target_premium' with this option)
strike_selection._comment_strike_step: For ATM_OFFSET mode: 0=ATM, +1=1 strike OTM, -1=1 strike ITM, +2=2 strikes OTM, etc.
strike_selection._comment_premium: For PREMIUM mode: Bot finds strike with premium closest to this value (e.g., 100 = ₹100 option)
strike_selection._comment_expiry_type: Options: CURRENT_WEEKLY (default), NEXT_WEEKLY, MONTHLY. Determines which expiry to trade.
strike_selection._comment_auto_switch: If true, automatically switches to next expiry on expiry day to avoid 0DTE volatility. If expiry_type weekly swiches to next weekly, if monthly switches to next monthly..etc. If false, trades current expiry until end.

active_indicators._comment: Available indicators - HTF: ema, utbot | LTF: ema, stochrsi, rsi, utbot
active_indicators._ltf_options: Switch LTF signals: ['ema','stochrsi','rsi'] or ['ema','utbot'] or ['utbot'] only

position_sizing._comment_lots: If mode is LOTS, bot will always buy this many lots regardless of price.

risk_management._comment_loss: Set to 0 to disable daily loss limit. Otherwise, bot stops new trades if loss exceeds this amount.
risk_management._comment_capital: Capital in ₹ to allocate per trade (e.g., 10000).
risk_management._comment_sl: Fixed Stop Loss % from entry price (e.g., 30 = 30%).
risk_management._comment_target: Target Profit % from entry price. Set to 0 for UNLIMITED target (ride the trend with TSL).
risk_management._comment_tsl: TSL Mode: PERCENT (uses trailing_stop_pct) or ATR (uses tsl_atr_multiplier x ATR).
risk_management._comment_positions: Maximum number of simultaneous open positions.
